# Easing Functions

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

## struct BackEase

Pulls back by [`amplitude`](#struct-backease) before moving (t³ − t·a·sin(πt)).

Example: 
```cpp
auto element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
element->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::TranslationY,
                         ui::DoubleAnimation{.to       = 0.0f,
                                             .duration = 400ms,
                                             .easing   = ui::BackEase{.amplitude = 0.5f}});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amplitude` | `float` | `1.0f` | How far it pulls back; 0 is plain t cubed. |
| `mode` | `EasingMode` | `EasingMode::EaseOut` | Which end the curve applies to. |

## struct BounceEase

[`bounces`](#struct-bounceease) bounces, each [`bounciness`](#struct-bounceease) times smaller than the last (clamped above 1).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bounces` | `int` | `3` | Number of bounces; negative is taken as 0. |
| `bounciness` | `float` | `2.0f` | Ratio between successive bounce heights. |
| `mode` | `EasingMode` | `EasingMode::EaseOut` | Which end the curve applies to. |

## struct ElasticEase

[`oscillations`](#struct-elasticease) swings, damped exponentially by [`springiness`](#struct-elasticease).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `oscillations` | `int` | `3` | Number of swings; negative is taken as 0. |
| `springiness` | `float` | `3.0f` | Exponential damping of the swings. |
| `mode` | `EasingMode` | `EasingMode::EaseOut` | Which end the curve applies to. |

## struct ExponentialEase

(e^(k·t) − 1) / (e^k − 1).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exponent` | `float` | `2.0f` | k in the formula; 0 is linear. |
| `mode` | `EasingMode` | `EasingMode::EaseOut` | Which end the curve applies to. |
